name: surdet
description: Surdet Engine - a mature, data-driven desktop galgame engine

scripts.build: npm run build -w @surdet/core && npm run build -w @surdet/cli && npm run build -w @surdet/renderer && npm run build -w @surdet/shell && npm run build -w surdet-editor && npm run build -w surdet-starter
scripts.test: npm run build -w @surdet/core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @surdet/core && npm run build -w @surdet/renderer && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
